notes:
Summary: mid-market product analytics vendor; building AI-powered in-product assistant + search/rerank for knowledge base and app events. Wants to start on Hosted API but intends to move to Dedicated for predictable throughput and data isolation. Sensitive to per-request cost, needs token-level cost visibility.

Key quotes (PM): "We need deterministic latency under 200ms p95 for chat in-app — can't have spikes during launch windows."

Security: customer requires SAML SSO for admin console, KMS integration for model payloads, audit logs retained 1 year, and EU data residency for EU customers.

Model preferences: prefers open models they can version pin; interested in smaller quantized variants for low-cost fallback, large Llama-style for quality. Wants model routing by route: support-chat -> high-quality model; in-app hints/search -> cheaper embeddings + small reranker.

POC ask: 4-week Dedicated pilot, 2-week canary (10% traffic) then 50% ramp, include automated fallback to hosted-compatible model variant in other region if Dedicated capacity saturated. Metrics: p95 latency, token cost per 1k, error rate, cost delta vs hosted baseline.
poc_plan:
POC objective: validate Dedicated capacity profile and routing logic for production chat + search.
Scope: 4 weeks Dedicated pilot on east-us and eu-west, Canary plan: week 1-2 canary at 10% of production traffic (non-critical tenant), week 3 ramp to 50% if metrics stable, week 4 full run and rollback dry-run.
Canary controls: metric thresholds (p95 latency < 220ms, error rate <0.5%, cost per 1k tokens < target). Auto-rollback triggers: sustained p95 > 350ms for 5 mins or error rate >2% for 3 mins.
Fallback routing: primary -> Dedicated east-us (pinned model v1.3.q4), fallback -> Hosted API variant (v1.3.q4-quant) or region failover -> Dedicated eu-west read replica (if eu users) depending on source region.
Model variants: high-quality full-precision model for chat, quantized 4-bit variant for noise-tolerant retrieval/rerank. Canary will exercise both: chat traffic to full-precision, search/rerank to quantized.
Observability: token-level cost dashboards, per-route latency histograms, trace ids included with responses, synthetic probes every 30s.
Success criteria: consistent p95 latency under threshold, <1% regression in response quality on eval prompts, <20% cost delta from hosted baseline at expected volume.

pricing_notes:
POC pricing: 4-week Dedicated pilot estimate provided in drive deck. Two options presented: reserved mini-pool (monthly commit) vs transient pilot credits. PM prefers pilot credits to avoid long commit.
Negotiation items: pilot credits amount, SLA window during pilot, overage rates, pricing per model variant. Finance requested example invoice and ARR projection; Jordan to share templated pricing sheet.
risks_and_mitigation:
Risk: VPC peering delays — mitigation: allow tunnel-based proxy for pilot.
Risk: SAML setup delays — mitigation: start SAML metadata exchange during canary prep.
Risk: quality regression with quantized fallback — mitigation: side-by-side evals, human eval on 50 prompt set, automated quality alerts tied to prompt set.
